title: Supreme Court Bar Association v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Supreme Court Bar Association v. Union of India, (1998) 4 SCC 409
content.holding: Article 142 powers cannot be used to bypass express statutory provisions or supplant substantive legislative codes like the Advocates Act 1961.
content.relevance: Limits of Supreme Court powers under Article 142.

evidence.note: 5-Judge Constitution Bench judgment in Writ Petition (Civil) No. 200 of 1995; 1998 INSC 234; (1998) 4 SCC 409; 1998 (2) SCR 795.
